notes: 02: no remote metadata collection at all. 03: no auto-collected metadata and no description field to edit. 04: edit covers url/title/topic only; no description, no note, tags reduced to a single topic string. 07: list shows title/url and topic group headers but no description or favicon. 09: only a single 'topic' string per bookmark, not one-or-more tags. 10: no autocomplete on topic entry. 12: search covers title/url/topic but description and note don't exist. 14: no #tag syntax. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 17-19: no unread/read-later flag or view. 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: list is fixed alphabetical topic grouping; no user-selectable sort key (date/title). 23: no note field or markdown rendering. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot or Internet Archive. 26-28: no archive concept or archived view. 29: no bundles/saved filters. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no display/personal settings.
